candidates.requirement: Initialize the notes obstack before assembling a source file.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput calls read_begin and then perform_an_assembly_pass. The pass creates standard sections through subseg_new; subseg_get allocates section information from notes.
candidates.failure_condition: The old entry bypasses main, where notes is now initialized, and read_begin no longer initializes it. Its first assembly pass therefore allocates from an uninitialized obstack.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete entry has no call to main or obstack_begin for notes. Its read_begin call no longer supplies that initialization; the fixed source-file argument cannot select another setup route.
